Priority
sections.content:
| # | Issue | Severity | File |
|---|-------|----------|------|
| 1 | `useListings` no cache between navigations | **High** | `lib/useListings.ts` |
| 2 | Saved hook - all cards re-render on any toggle | **High** | `lib/saved.ts` |
| 3 | Admin reloads all data on every focus | **High** | `app/admin.tsx` |
| 4 | Profile fetches listings instead of filtering | **Medium** | `app/(tabs)/profile.tsx` |
| 5 | `ListingCard` not memoized | **Medium** | `components/ListingCard.tsx` |
| 6 | Admin stats/countBy inline computations | **Medium** | `app/admin.tsx` |
| 7 | `ChipRow` not memoized | **Low** | `components/FilterSheet.tsx` |
| 8 | Image `cachePolicy` not set | **Low** | anywhere photos render |

The `useListings` cache (item 1) is the single highest-leverage fix since it cuts a Supabase round-trip on every tab switch.
